answer: The jury's own reward depends on rejecting low-quality answers, creating a shared incentive among honest graders to spot coordinated fakery, so a Sybil cluster collapses under the weight of its own low scores. This is why the network can stay open without a central gatekeeper: the economics of reputation do the filtering that a trusted authority otherwise would.. The system stays honest because reputation is unforgeable and only earned through accepted attestations, so freshly minted aliases genuinely cannot swing a verdict.
